versions.changelog: Document cross-skill relationships in all SKILL.md files

arxiv-summarizer-orchestrator 0.1.0 initial release:

- Introduces end-to-end orchestration for periodic arXiv collection and reporting, integrating three sub-skills: arxiv-search-collector, arxiv-paper-processor, and arxiv-batch-reporter.
- Supports configurable manual language selection applied throughout all markdown outputs.
- Provides parallel (default: max 5) or serial paper processing strategies.
- Documents flexible workflows for query generation, artifact collection, per-paper summarization, and final report assembly.
- Designed for scheduled (e.g., cron) runs with organized output structure and workflow checklist.
